entries.title: Phoenix / turbo cannons and Order of the Phoenix
entries.note: Actual native Furious4100HP Phoenix checkpoint; other life pools cleared before capture. Invulnerable input-only observer; normal weapon and Retina inputs; no recorder HP/phase/clock writes. Four shuffled corner origins, continuous outside routing, direction-matched rushes, authored rear/profile bank and roll, random north/south depth approach.4.2s accelerating wing/flame charge darkens the lava;8–12 committed digital-fire whole-body copies grow into the foreground with landing Retinas. Charge-down, offscreen exit, twisting foreground return and vulnerable recovery. Ordinary-movement left/right escape routes separately verified without GOD on Normal/Hard/Furious. Native cannon gate, HP, hit flash, copied-life return and final destruction preserved.
